newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Iranian foreign minister to visit Pakistan soon.
newsitem.headline: Iranian foreign minister to visit Pakistan soon.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati will visit Pakistan soon to extend invitations to a summit meeting of the Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) in Tehran in December, a Foreign Ministry source said.
He said no firm dates for Velayati's visit had been set.

The official news agency APP said Velayati would meet President Farooq Leghari, Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif and other officials in Islamabad next week to deliver invitations from Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani to the OIC summit.
It said Velayati would also discuss Afghanistan and the Kashmir dispute with Pakistani leaders.
Pakistan, in the middle of a transfer of power to Sharif's new government, has no foreign minister at the moment. Sharif is expected to name his cabinet in the next day or two.
APP said the OIC's regular three-day summit conference would start on December 9. Foreign ministers would hold preparatory meetings on December 7 and 8.
Pakistan is hosting a special OIC summit in Islamabad on March 23 as part of its golden jubilee celebrations to mark 50 years of independence from Britain.
